&variables;
&step_stop_server;
Deprovision the server Submit script to deprovision a server.
Delete and unmount ZFS If created, delete and unmount the ZFS $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_ZFS} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_ZFS} Run commands to delete the SAF certificate and keyring. 1 true
jcl/delete-zfs.jcl JCL
Delete instance directory Delete the directory for this server instance $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SERVER} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SERVER}
Submitting script to delete server. 1 true
if [ -d ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} ]; then echo "removing server directory ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}" rm -rf ${instance-SERVER_USER_DIR}/servers/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} fi #if(${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR} && ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR} != "") if [ -d ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} ]; then echo "removing output directory ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}" rm -rf ${instance-SERVER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME} fi #end echo "delete shared class cache files" rm /tmp/javasharedresources/C290M11F1A64_*_sharedcc_${instance-SERVER_STC_NAME}_G43L00 if [ $? -gt 0 ]; then echo "no class cache files needed to be deleted" fi
shell-JCL
Delete ICSF Access Delete access to the ICSF profiles in CSFSERV $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY}
${stopServer_console.stepState}=="Complete" || ${stopServer_console.stepState} == "Skipped" Check that the issue_stop stepState is Complete
Executes a REXX program to delete the SAF certificate and keyring. 1 true
extensions/deleteIcsfAccess.rexx TSO-REXX-JCL 1024
Delete DSNR access Delete access to DSNR RRSAF and DIST $!{instance-UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY} $!{instance-UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY}
Submit jcl to execute step 1 true
extensions/deleteDsnrAccess.rexx TSO-REXX-JCL 1024

${stopServer_console.stepState}=="Complete" || ${stopServer_console.stepState} == "Skipped" Check that the issue_stop stepState is Complete

Skip if no Crypto Connect configuration is required ${instance-CRYPTO_CONNECT_SUPPORT_REQUIRED} == "false" Skipped
Executes a REXX program to delete access to Crypto Connect related resources. 1 true
extensions/deleteAccessCryptoConnect.rexx TSO-REXX-JCL 1024

jcl/delete-server-proc.jcl JCL

extensions/deleteSecurity.rexx TSO-REXX-JCL 1024

extensions/deleteKeyAccess.rexx TSO-REXX-JCL 1024
